name: What makes luxury custom homes in Bel Air or Beverly Hills different?

mainEntity.name: Why do ultra-luxury Los Angeles custom homes cost so much more than standard custom homes?
mainEntity.text: Why do ultra-luxury Los Angeles custom homes cost so much more than standard custom homes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ultra-luxury custom homes are different because nearly every part of the project is more complex. The architecture may use larger openings, custom structures, specialty materials, and highly detailed interior finishes. Mechanical, electrical, and smart-home systems are often more advanced. Site challenges, privacy requirements, and design coordination also tend to be greater in high-end neighborhoods. In these projects, the budget is driven less by square footage alone and more by the level of customization and execution. Homeowners should expect more time in design development, more detailed approvals, and more coordination among specialists. A luxury custom home is as much a precision project as it is a construction project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Luxury homes in areas like Bel Air and Beverly Hills cost more because they often include complex architecture, premium finishes, larger spans, advanced systems, security features, and more demanding site conditions. Design expectations and execution standards are also much higher.
